description: This file defines the DeploymentPlanService class, which implements IDeploymentPlanService. It manages deployment plans, including retrieving, creating, updating, and checking user permissions related to deployment plans within OrchardCore.

classes.name: DeploymentPlanService
classes.description: Service class for managing deployment plans, including retrieval, creation, update, and permission checks.

methods.name: GetDeploymentPlans
methods.description: Retrieves all deployment plans, caching the result.

methods.name: DoesUserHavePermissionsAsync
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to manage deployment plans and export.

methods.name: DoesUserHaveExportPermissionAsync
methods.description: Checks if the current user has export permission for deployment plans.

methods.name: GetDeploymentPlansAsync
methods.description: Returns deployment plans matching specified names.

methods.name: CreateOrUpdateDeploymentPlansAsync
methods.description: Creates or updates deployment plans in the database.
